T09 is present, and the ambient temperature was checked and is 28.6°C, which is above 31°C? No — 28.6°C is below 31°C.  

According to [1]:  
- If ambient temperature is above 31°C, lower it and retest.  
- If ambient temperature is at most 31°C and T09 persists after retesting, replace the cooler.  

Here, ambient is 28.6°C (≤31°C), and T09 persists after retesting.  

Therefore, the cooler must be replaced.  

Disposition: Authorize replacement of the cooler.  
Supporting condition: Ambient temperature is 28.6°C (≤31°C), and T09 persists after ambient check and diagnostic rerun.
